title: Hanger Mall
content: First time shopper, long time visitor. I’ve been to plenty of these night malls but this one is the spookiest, I didn’t think it existed in the real world? But I saw this picture and immediately knew this is the Anxiety Airport Mall / Grocery Store from some of my least cool mall dreams. Anyone got a lead on what this is? Has anyone else been here? Also does anyone ever go to Hotel World? Frequent flyer here
